steps.content: By the time you arrive, torches are already burning in the town square. A heavy gloom blankets the entire town. Fog obscures the moon, while howling winds whip up dust and dead leaves.
Villagers gather before the statue in the square. From the letters you found, you know this statue represents the legendary Witch who protects the town, and this is where the ritual will take place.
Eleanor weaves through the crowd nimbly like a fish, squeezing forward in search of the best spot for the "show," but ultimately fails to advance much.

steps.speaker: Eleanor
steps.content: Mmph... Next comes the most crucial part of the ritual, right? Hmm, there are so many people in front of the statue. Some are even kneeling on the ground...

You squeeze through to Eleanor's side. Nearby, several people who are obviously fellow players hunch excitedly over the glowing screens in their hands, snapping pictures of the statue. How did they manage to smuggle those devices in? There really are rule-breakers everywhere.
The surrounding villagers glare with anger, yet none of them try to intervene.
Prima remains silent, anxiously staring at the statue in the center of the square.
Dong, dong, dong.

Three dull strikes echo from the center of the square, making your head buzz. The sound draws everyone's attention as the crowd instinctively parts beside you. Three figures in gray cloaks lead the way with torches, dragging... someone behind them.
The person's head is covered with a burlap sack. From the clothing, it appears to be an adult woman.
You crane your neck to watch every movement on the platform. Through the gaps in the crowd, you see the woman with the burlap sack over her head kneeling before the Witch statue.
Around her, the cloaked figures behave strangely, first making several bizarre hand gestures, then dipping their fingers into some kind of pigment before drawing mysterious patterns around the woman.
Then, they begin shouting loudly.
It's a language you can't understand, each word seemingly yelled with such force that it threatens to tear their throats apart.
Responding to the cloaked figures' calls, the surrounding villagers begin shouting as well, raising various objects and banging them together in a cacophony of noise.
The chaotic, piercing sounds stab at your eardrums, shaking your heart and clouding your mind with confusion.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Um... Is this also... just acting?
Agitated by the noises, you lean close to Eleanor's ear to ask, but she just stares fixedly at the people on the platform. Is that excitement in her eyes? Or some kind of... fervor?
You turn to look at Prima, but she too is completely entranced by the ritual, her cheeks glowing bright red in the firelight.

As the preparations seem complete, the cloaked figures reveal their faces. One is the mayor, and the other, to your surprise, is the burly Butcher who was in the same room as you earlier! Why would he...
In the moonlight, you see that familiar long ax now in the mayor's hands. The blade gleams icily as he swings it down at the woman kneeling on the platform, her head still covered by the burlap sack.

steps.speaker: Woman with Sack Over Head
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f><size=24>AH</size> <size=34>AHH</size> <size=44>AHHH!</size></color>
A piercing scream cuts through the chaotic noise, jolting you out of the momentary daze.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Hey!
Why doesn't anyone seem shocked by this horrifying scene? Is this also just part of the game? Are you overreacting because it's your first time?
You stare in disbelief as the villagers and fellow players around you all seem fervently immersed in this horrifyingly realistic ritual.
It's as if you're the abnormal one for not being sucked in by the performance.
But... but... this feeling... something is definitely wrong!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Out of my way!
Your professional instincts take over as you push through the crowd to the front and leap onto the circular platform.

The wound on the woman's body isn't fake, and the blood isn't just makeup! Just as you try to examine her more closely, the woman's corpse suddenly transforms into wax and melts away. You search the entire platform but find no mechanism that could create this kind of "performance."

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: There's no hidden mechanism... It's not magic or hypnosis either... This is...
There's only one explanation for this grotesque scene before you! Something you're all too familiar with... Mania!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Where are the staff? Stop this game immediately!
You shout at the crowd, but no one responds. You turn to the mayor who wielded the ax earlier and grab him by the collar, only to find his expression disturbingly strange.
You see both fervor and numbness in everyone's eyes. They have all been acting strangely since those three loud chimes. Are they hallucinating? And why are they all looking up at something above?

You follow their gazes upward to find the moon, fog-wrapped and hourglass-shaped, which seems to have flipped itself over. Its color appears deeper than you remember, with edges rimmed in an ominous crimson, resembling a half-lidded, bloodshot eye.

The moon hangs lower now, its red light seeping into every crack of the circular platform like raindrops. But instead of emitting the curse-breaking radiance promised in the legend, it turns pitch-black and viscous, reeking of rust and decay.

A tall shadow approaches the mayor. It's the Butcher. He pries your hands open, freeing the mayor from your grip. The mayor stares up at the moon, muttering unintelligibly, though you can clearly sense the fear and disbelief in his voice.
The mayor then staggers forward in despair and collapses to his knees before the Witch statue.

steps.speaker: Mayor
steps.content: The Trial continues... This person... is not the Witch... The ritual... must continue... Hurry, onto the next one...
At the mayor's announcement, the surrounding crowd erupts in loud, disappointed boos.

steps.speaker: Mayor
steps.content: I'll leave the next one to you... I have faith in you...
The mayor presses the ax heavily into the Butcher's palms. The Butcher accepts it solemnly, his eyes growing resolute.

steps.speaker: Butcher
steps.content: ...Leave it to me. This time, I will not fail.
The Butcher hefts the ax in his hand and begins scanning the crowd below, like a predator choosing which prey he will slaughter today.
[Scene with Red Filter]
The blood moon hangs low, engulfing the previously reddish sky in a deep crimson.

steps.speaker: Resident A
steps.content: Not enough... We're running out of time! Kill another one... Kill another one! You? It's you, isn't it!

steps.speaker: Resident B
steps.content: Don't pick me... I'm not the Witch... Please don't kill me...

The crowd grows frenzied under the pressure of the blood moon. Not wanting to be chosen by the Butcher, they push and shove one another. Some try to escape, only to be violently dragged back by others. If this continues, the situation will spiral completely out of control!

Without hesitation, light flashes from your hand. This is the weapon that gives you confidence, which also confirms that Mania has indeed invaded this space right now. You prepare yourself for battle, ready to search for the hidden culprit.
However, the enemy you must face catches you completely off guard.

The villagers who were just shoving each other chaotically now all turn toward you. Numerous pairs of red eyes reflecting the crimson moonlight stare right at you, as if pinning you to the circular ceremony platform.

steps.speaker: Resident A
steps.content: What peculiar sorcery! I know... You must be the Witch!
